name: CaseOverlayTextFillStageDerived
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "overlay-text-fill-stage-derived" (geometry). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a TEXT-bearing part that genuinely FILLS its pinned ancestor — where the ancestor's own box is the CAPTURE STAGE's content box (288px = stage 320 − 2×16), and moves only because the ancestor's gutters do
